_comment: Passages the pastor reads next to the RV1960 and the KJV before approving a Bible, grouped by doctrine (see healthReport.md). doctrine = where a translation shows its theology; check = what to look for. Ranges stay inside one chapter. random_sample = how many other verses, picked at random per Bible, also get a verdict.
